svg.aria-label: The four real attention heads in block 1 of the trained model, reading But soft, what. Head 1 looks one letter back. Head 2 spreads its attention over the last few letters. Head 3 looks two letters back. Head 4 looks one letter back, more loosely.
svg.text: Four meetings at once: the real heads in block 1
Same letters, same moment, four different questions. Bigger dot = more attention.
Each row is a letter at the meeting; grey squares are later letters, which it may not listen to. Real numbers from my trained model.
